residual.architecture: three independent 1-21-1 ReLU components; fixed hidden hinges, fitted output weights
residual.scope: Controlled known-Lipschitz residual bound. This does not certify CROWN, polynomial or symbolic-remainder floating-point arithmetic.
residual.data_error_arithmetic: Exact rational arithmetic on stored binary coefficients; sine polynomial plus |v|^49/49! remainder; constants rounded upward to float64.
residual.region_arithmetic: Sorted prefix/suffix weighted-distance lookup with exact rational preprocessing, an outward radius about the rounded midpoint, and directed nextafter steps. Requires ordinary IEEE basic-operation rounding without unsafe reassociation.

assurance: Gatekeeper disabled: no candidate safety verification or reachable-set calculation.

recording_info.timing_scope: Synchronous simulated-time planning. Computation delay is measured, not inserted into the plant trajectory. No real-time guarantee.
recording_info.learning: Residual and neural controller trained before this flight; no online parameter updates.
